verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a self-hosting deployment path, including an embedded TURN server and domain/SSL requirements. A hands-on probe booted the Apache-2.0 `livekit-server` locally with no account or key, and the open-source agents framework installs and imports from pip/npm keylessly. missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of an agent worker running end-to-end against a self-hosted server, and no evidence that Cloud features (LiveKit Inference, Agent Builder, managed deployments/rollback) are available when self-hosted.
